scope: Offline, cryptographically signed synthetic Source→Genesis→Transfer→Merge with valid upstream VM witnesses. Fabricated funding means no node or real-chain acceptance.

provenance.signatureScope: Public scalar 1, deterministic ECDSA test signatures, fabricated funding only. Never import real wallet keys.
provenance.digestEncoding: upstreamDigestHex is Sighash.sighash reversed hash; digestBytesHex is raw SHA256d(preimage) for Rust/secp256k1. Their byte sequences are reverses.
provenance.reuseScope: No fetching: transfer reuses genesis parent/source ancestor; merge reuses the one split parent and the one genesis ancestor for both token inputs; fee funding always uses same-batch change.
